name: supply-chain
description: Deep supply-chain operator expertise for OpenAI Codex: 55 enterprise-system skills and 16 end-to-end business workflows, four independent-review agents, and session-start safety guidance that keeps the model classifying and pausing consequential connector actions for human approval. Expertise + judgment; it owns no tools or connectors.

interface.longDescription: 55 enterprise-system skills (SAP, Oracle, Kinaxis, Manhattan, Coupa, Veeva, and more) across ERP, planning, warehouse, transportation, procurement, quality, MES, maintenance, customs, risk, PLM, and CRM; 16 end-to-end business workflows; four independent-review agents; and session-start safety guidance that has the model classify each connector action (read / write / destructive / outbound) and pause consequential ones for human approval. The plugin owns expertise + judgment, not tools or connectors — you bring your own MCP connectors, and Codex's own approval flow gates the actual tool calls.
defaultPrompt: How does SAP handle a partial goods receipt on a PO?
Walk me through a DC stock-split for a scarce SKU and stage the WMS allocation for approval.
Reconcile on-hand vs WMS before we act on the number.
